summary.name: Notes (Daino Notes)
summary.one_liner: Notes is a free, cross-platform block-based note-taking app (also called Daino Notes) for Windows, Linux and macOS with Markdown rendering, fast search and global hotkeys.
use_cases: quick capture of thoughts and ideas
writing long text with fast performance
planning and prioritizing tasks on a task board
writing Markdown notes with live rendering
organizing notes with drag and drop
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a note-taking app with a block-based editor that supports titles, headers, lists, to-do items, quotes and images, with drag-and-drop reordering. It renders Markdown in real time and offers a distraction-free mode. Notes are stored locally first on the device, and a fast search box finds notes. A global shortcut (Win+Shift+N, Ctrl+N on macOS, Meta+Shift+N on Linux) summons the window, and many local shortcuts cover creating, deleting, formatting and navigating notes. A Task Board view is mentioned for prioritizing tasks.
notable: Global hotkey to summon the notes window from any app
Local-first storage saves notes directly on the device
Real-time Markdown rendering in a block editor
Listed in awesome-mac as open source and freeware
caveats: Mobile versions are mentioned only as coming soon
Performance benchmark claims are based on the vendor's own test on a 2017 MacBook Air
